description: All 24 dungeons (8 factions x 3). F001 dungeons derived from the realm template pending approval. F002-F008 from approved faction docs; F004 storm-lane renamed (real myth creature name removed).

dungeons.name: The Verdict Colonnade
dungeons.summary: light-patch hazard run; noonlight burns where the Glaresworn swim (derived — pending approval)

dungeons.name: The Shifting Meridian
dungeons.summary: the day's exact center moves; shadow-routing puzzle (derived — pending approval)

dungeons.name: The Blinding Processional
dungeons.summary: Glaresworn nest where light itself is the enemy (derived — pending approval)

dungeons.name: The Storm-Oath Bridge
dungeons.summary: the span holds where oaths are visible and breaks where eaten

dungeons.name: The Betrayal Memory Hollow
dungeons.summary: the Forgotten Banner's hall; doubt is terrain that dissolves

dungeons.name: The Root Gauntlet
dungeons.summary: beneath the bridge; oath-eaters nesting in the rootwork

dungeons.name: The Laurel Threshold Arena
dungeons.summary: trial arena; laurel-bound champions are echoes who entered with power but without purpose

dungeons.name: The Oracle Vapor Colonnade
dungeons.summary: maddened seers consumed by false visions

dungeons.name: The Aegis Court Duelling Ground
dungeons.summary: trial road fractures into zones where different legal codes hold

dungeons.name: The Mirror Lake Sanctuary
dungeons.summary: the lake reflects what the Gate wants you to believe

dungeons.name: The Storm-Wind Lane Crossing
dungeons.summary: torii act as storm-bridges; distortion-bled Stormmoot terrain inside shrine-space (RENAMED from 'Tengu Wind Lane' — tengu is a real myth creature; cross-faction corruption ties to F002)

dungeons.name: The Phased Boundary Sanctum
dungeons.summary: the material/spirit boundary thins; half the room exists on the other side

dungeons.name: The Oathbond Labyrinth
dungeons.summary: living maze grown from promises and bloodline debts; read the terrain, don't trust the path

dungeons.name: The Mound Descent
dungeons.summary: beast-realm predators nest in wounded roots that hold the Gate stable: fight WITHOUT destroying the terrain (moral-combat dilemma)

dungeons.name: The Avalora Mirror Wound
dungeons.summary: the never-healed scar of the Ascension Collapse; the Hollow weaponize grief with copies of lost deities — fight by witnessing grief without becoming part of it

dungeons.name: The Memory-Burn Corridor
dungeons.summary: the Gate leaks radiance that erases what it illuminates; what remains when memory is stripped?

dungeons.name: The Shattered Hall
dungeons.summary: the Vault's great lights have fractured; the Shattered Engine consumes any light trying to rejoin the original radiance

dungeons.name: The Glass Stair Ascent
dungeons.summary: stair-phantoms create false steps with mirage-light; climb by refraction, not by sight

dungeons.name: The Debt Ledger Vault
dungeons.summary: the Ledger records every Gate transaction including pre-Collapse debts; the False Pact Wardens charge YOU for every action taken (action-cost combat)

dungeons.name: The Ash Market Trading Floor
dungeons.summary: trade debt ONTO Hollow entities; every trade creates a new relationship — and relationships are chains

dungeons.name: The Execution Sigil Rewrite Chamber
dungeons.summary: clause-eaters rewrite the Gate's contract mid-fight; counter by rewriting sigils live — choosing WHEN to be vulnerable

dungeons.name: The Cedar-Mist Switchbacks
dungeons.summary: the descent path that rearranges behind you; patience beats speed — rushing spawns Grayfallen, waiting starves them

dungeons.name: The Salmon Gates
dungeons.summary: the Hollow have dammed the Return Run; free the river WITHOUT breaking it (constraint-combat)

dungeons.name: The Sleeping Ridge Caldera
dungeons.summary: the volcanic vents at the Gate's root; the floor is a timing puzzle of breath and eruption
